description: What kind of source is this page or document?
instructions: What kind of source is the document in `text`, judging by its content and its `url`?

official_docs.what: Documentation written by the project or vendor that owns the subject
official_docs.not_for: Forum answers or tutorials by third parties

api_reference.what: A reference listing of an API's types, methods, fields or commands

release_notes.what: A changelog, release note or upgrade guide

source_code.what: Source code or a code comment or README inside a repository

issue_or_pr.what: An issue, pull request or code review discussion

forum_or_qa.what: A forum thread, Q&A answer or community post

blog_or_tutorial.what: A blog post, article or tutorial by a third party

output: Researcher: the `source kind` label on each evidence line in the research note, so official sources outrank forum answers.
